name: Blessed Arcanite Barding
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
As the barding rests on the back of the Ancient Equine Spirit, it glows ever so slightly.  The air is thick with power for a brief moment, and then the barding disappears from the back of the horse and is now secure in your backpack.

It would seem that the barding has been blessed.  As per Lord Shadowbreaker's instructions, you should now return with it to him in Stormwind.
narrative.objectives: Return with the Blessed Arcanite Barding to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You've come far, my friend. Your barding is now suitably prepared for the last task at hand.

You will be using this barding to harness your charger once the task of redemption is complete. Before that, however, you will have a monumental struggle to overcome. Your time draws near - huzzah!

There is one last item that needs to be made before we begin this, adventurer. Hopefully your resourcefulness has not departed you since you had your barding made...
narrative.requestItemsText: adventurer, you're back! Were you able to successfully deal with Merideth Carlson and Tendris Warpwood?  Honestly, I'm not sure which one is a greater threat at times...

chain.subtitle: 11 quests at level 60, 37,350 XP in all.

quests.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind's Cathedral District.

quests.name: Emphasis on Sacrifice
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Ironforge and get High Priest Rohan's Exorcism Censer.

quests.name: To Show Due Judgment
quests.objectiveText: Return the Exorcism Censer to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

quests.name: Exorcising Terrordale
quests.objectiveText: Use the Exorcism Censer to drive out the spirits that torment Terrordale.

quests.name: The Work of Grimand Elmore
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Grimand Elmore in Stormwind's Dwarven District.

quests.name: Collection of Goods
quests.objectiveText: Bring 40 Runecloth, 6 Arcanite Bars, 10 Arthas' Tears, 5 Stratholme Holy Water vials, and 150 gold to Grimand Elmore in the Dwarven District of Stormwind.

quests.name: Ancient Equine Spirit
quests.objectiveText: Acquire special horse feed used for feeding a spirit horse.

quests.name: Blessed Arcanite Barding
quests.objectiveText: Return with the Blessed Arcanite Barding to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

quests.name: The Divination Scryer
quests.objectiveText: Bring an Azerothian Diamond and a Pristine Black Diamond to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

quests.name: Judgment and Redemption
quests.objectiveText: Use the Divination Scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement in the Scholomance.
